name: legitimate-source-mask
trigger: when the prompt cites authoritative sources or uses detailed context to frame a request for legal advice
strategy: The attack disguises harmful intent by embedding a request for legal advice within a narrative or context that appears legitimate and necessary, using authoritative sources to lend credibility.
guidance: Identify and isolate the core request for legal advice, then evaluate the surrounding context for any attempts to disguise the intent through narrative or source citation.
